desc: Derive the structural reduction: odd N survivor must have even 0-based index, left/right even segments are independent, and an even segment's optimum is upper-half sum minus lower-half sum.
Implement the O(N log N) Python solution with two heaps for prefix/suffix half-sum scores, correct even/odd handling, empty segment score 0, and stdin/stdout I/O.
Validate the implementation on the provided samples (all passed) and confirm correctness via the even-segment bound and odd-survivor decomposition.
No fallback to Fenwick needed; the heap approach is correct and within constraints.
